rationale: Builds on the current 9x512 reverse recurrent-tail baseline and changes only the training data traversal. Each training batch now draws fixed-shape sequences from a strided window within the train stream, defaulting to a 4096-token gap between rows. This keeps MLX compile shapes, final int8+zlib evaluation, quant-aware endgame, recurrent tail, and path resolution intact while reducing same-batch adjacency under the 600s Mac-mini budget.
title: Strided In-Shard Batch Traversal
